updating the current format; migration tests must read the historical shape.

## Schema six freeze, 27 October 2026

The v6 fixtures were frozen before the ignition widget schema change, using
production schema-six codecs from `f0ad9035e12d6c1b1011004c5927434577475460`
and the repository's `nightly-2026-10-18` pin. Production configuration sources
and VERSION were unchanged. Default files were copied byte-for-byte from
`configs/default.{eav,json}`. Neither historical fixtures nor frozen bytes are
regenerated by the regression tests.

Capacity files came from the existing `v4_capacity.rs` test's
`maximum_documents_fit_and_slot_matches_owned` export hook. The historical
`v4-` output prefix was renamed to `v6-capacity-1x1`/`v6-capacity-2x2` without
changing bytes. Each contains eight views; 1x1 has 64 widgets and 2x2 has 16.
Both retain three bands per widget, maximum escaped labels/messages, nondefault
warning windows/latch/snooze, controls, fuel, LED, source routes and timing.
These capacity fixtures deliberately use Oil/Fahrenheit throughout.

The mixed pair was generated by a temporary typed test in config-tools
`tests/project.rs`, calling `validate`, `to_json` and `compile`; the writer was
removed after freezing. It clones the eight default widgets into eight views
with IDs 1..64, boot view 8 and LandscapeInverted default orientation. Views 1/2
explicitly select Landscape/LandscapeInverted; other views inherit. Boost cycles
FollowBoost/Bar/Psi/Kpa, Oil alternates Celsius/Fahrenheit and Lambda cycles
Lambda/Afr/LambdaAndAfr with matching `display.afr`. Battery retains Volts, so
all eight scalar channels and all ten historical readouts occur. History is
`[10,20,30,40,50,60,70,900]`, reduced motion is true and hold time is 1500 ms.
BLE stays disabled with ObdLinkCx, **synthetic** RandomStatic peer
`[193,2,3,4,5,6]`, and 30000/5000/200 ms connect/response/gap settings.
These bytes do not represent a real peer, enable traffic or qualify vehicle data.

`legacy_v6.rs` compares binary and JSON imports, preserving every historical JSON
field while updating the schema number and adding Global ignition popup layout.
It also checks canonical re-encoding and current boot-slot admission.
The mixed dashboard also appears byte-for-byte inside the frozen
[complete artwork project](../../../dashboard-config-tools/tests/fixtures/README.md).
